thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: prod-canary serving errors spike — image mismatch detected in canary cluster (prod-canary). Investigate.
priya: i'm on it. i'm seeing 502s on the canary endpoint.
alex: which service?
priya: backend/llm-proxy canary. traffic ~5% but errors started ~5m ago after the release.
jing: logs show mismatch between image digest and manifest: container tried to pull digest A but runtime resolved to digest B.
priya: here's the pull error from the node logs:
```
time="2026-03-15T09:12:03Z" level=error msg="failed to unpack image" err="manifest for registry.redwood.internal/llm-proxy:canary not found (digest mismatch)"
```
alex: that smells like a registry retag / cache poisoning or CI pushed the wrong tag. any recent releases?
priya: release job completed ~09:07 UTC — pipeline succeeded. engineer @alex triggered.
priya: listing artifacts now.
priya: `gcloud artifacts docker images list registry.redwood.internal/llm-proxy --format=json` shows two manifests for tag "canary" with different digests.
sam: ouch. multiple manifests for same tag. that usually means someone's pushing with `--force` or the registry accepted a cross-arch manifest rewrite.
jing: checking CI logs: build job used builder cache key that matched a previous build, then `docker push registry/...:canary` succeeded but with old manifest overlay.
alex: i pushed a hotfix earlier this week and reused the same tag pattern. i thought our release job pins digest but apparently the canary tag is still mutable in our pipeline. my bad.
priya: immediate mitigation options: 1) pause canary routing (block new requests), 2) rollback canary replicas to prior image digest, 3) flip feature flag kill-switch to force traffic to stable. thoughts?
oncall: page SRE runbook: reduce canary traffic to 0 and abort rollout.
sam: agree — reduce traffic + rollback. priya can you run the rollback?
priya: doing `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/llm-proxy llm-proxy=registry.redwood.internal/llm-proxy@sha256:0b9...` to previous digest.
priya: running now. output:
```
deployment.apps/llm-proxy image updated
waiting for rollout...
deployment "llm-proxy" successfully rolled out
```
jing: i also toggled the canary route in gateway to 0%: `POST /admin/route-adjust` body `{ "service":"llm-proxy","canary_percent":0 }` (internal)
priya: feature flag kill-switch for new model routing toggled: `ffctrl set llm_proxy_new_model false` — confirmed.
alex: i've stopped the CI release job and revoked the short-lived registry token used by that job.
sam: good. i recommend we also set a registry immutable tag policy for `canary` until we fix pipeline. file a policy ticket.
priya: agreed. creating JIRA: INFRA-3921 "enforce immutable canary tags; prevent force-push" 
priya: quick customer impact: current canary traffic was 5% of total. errors ramped to ~80% for canary users only. production stable users unaffected. no major customer-facing outage.
oncall: please quantify: how many requests failed?
jing: querying metrics: between 09:07-09:16 UTC, canary error rate 82%, ~12k requests failed (~0.6% of total platform requests).
oncall: SLO risk low for prod but we'll run postmortem. notify support to log an incident note in Zendesk for any users linked to canary.
priya: notified support, sending template: "Canary release for llm-proxy caused transient 502s for canary traffic; rollout aborted; rollback complete; fix in progress."
alex: root cause hypothesis: CI reused builder cache and pushed an older manifest under the mutable `canary` tag; registry accepted cross-arch/multi-manifest rewrite which caused digest flip.
sam: temporal mitigation: add a registry hook to reject pushes that rewrite existing tag to a different manifest digest unless explicitly allowed.
priya: i've blocked tag `canary` from being written via our artifact ACLs for now (set to read-only for CI principal).
jing: also found that our deploy pipeline uses `docker push registry/...:${TAG}` without computing digest and then uses tag in k8s manifests; change needed to pin digests in manifests pre-deploy.
oncall: handoff: @sam will own the mitigation + follow-up for the next 4 hours. priya you stay on for cleanup. alex, file a small PR to change release job to capture and publish digest after push.
sam: taking it. immediate todo list in thread: 
- block further writes to `canary` tag (done)
- make CI publish digest and use pinned digest in k8s rollout (alex)
- add registry policy to reject tag rewrites (infra)
- update runbooks and FF rollback test (priya)
- postmortem and customer comms (sam/priya)

priya: i'm re-running a verification against staging to ensure manifests are immutable now.
priya: staging push to `canary` failed as expected with policy error. good.
jing: assigned INFRA-3921 and SEC-1247 for registry policy/ACL.
alex: will open PR in 30m to change pipeline to record digest and update deploy job.
sam: we'll schedule a postmortem meeting at 15:00 UTC. invite sent.
priya: anything else urgent?
alex: sorry again on the accidental tag reuse. i'll add a preflight check to the job.
priya: all good. thanks for fast responses. triage complete, rollback confirmed, customer impact logged. leaving notes for oncall handoff.
oncall: handover acknowledged. sam owns mitigation. incident-bot: incident severity set to SEV2, creating incident doc. :white_check_mark:
